product.olivetti-p500.summary: The Micro Channel system with a 386SX and alternative ST-506 and ESDI controllers.
product.olivetti-p500.history: The Olivetti service guide documents P500 (the Micro Channel system with a 386SX and alternative ST-506 and ESDI controllers).
product.olivetti-p500.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA823 / BA827 / BA242 / BA243 · PVGA1 · ST-506 / ESDI.
product.olivetti-p500.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 1.18.
product.olivetti-p500.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-p500.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
